scope: One NayaNET app, journey, or bounded interface change
authority_note: This instrument does not amend or compete with the ratified NayaPOWER System Scorecard. Project-specific contracts and Human Director authority remain higher.

scoring_rules.unknown: UNSCORED is not zero, pass, or implied readiness; name the missing evidence and owner.
scoring_rules.aggregation: Do not use an average to conceal a dimension below threshold or a failed hard gate. Every dimension is judged independently.
evidence_required: exact repository commit or deployed version
test, observation, screenshot, metric, or reproducible evidence
scoring_rules.independence: The implementer may submit a provisional score. An independent reviewer must reproduce critical evidence before release recommendation.

dimensions.name: Human value
dimensions.question: Does this materially improve the user's world or accomplish a meaningful job?
blockers: Feature exists only to fill a dashboard or template

dimensions.name: Purpose and clarity
dimensions.question: Can the user understand where they are, what matters, what they can do, and what happens next?

dimensions.name: Information architecture
dimensions.question: Are rooms, objects, navigation, journeys, hierarchy, and screen sequence logical?

dimensions.name: Visual identity and craft
dimensions.question: Does the surface feel unmistakably Naya, coherent, premium, precise, and alive without visual noise?

dimensions.name: Interaction and causality
dimensions.question: Does every visible control behave as expected and produce an observable, recoverable result?

dimensions.name: Intelligence and usefulness
dimensions.question: Are summaries, rankings, recommendations, and insights relevant, explainable, timely, and actionable?

dimensions.name: Truth, privacy, and safety
dimensions.question: Are data, authority, provenance, freshness, permissions, and risks represented and enforced correctly?
blockers: Fake liveness or demo data presented as real

dimensions.name: Accessibility and inclusion
dimensions.question: Can people with differing abilities and input modes understand and operate the app?
blockers: Critical journey unavailable to keyboard/assistive tech

dimensions.name: Responsive quality and performance
dimensions.question: Does it work beautifully across actual viewports, orientations, input modes, and runtime conditions?
evidence: Core Web Vitals or explicit lab evidence

dimensions.name: Reliability and evolution
dimensions.question: Is it tested, maintainable, reusable, observable, reversible where needed, and able to improve without duplicate truth?
blockers: No way to recover from critical failure

hard_gates: No unauthorized read or write path
Every visible action has a real capability and recovery behavior
Primary user journey is complete and independently tested
No clipping or inaccessible critical interaction at required viewports
WCAG 2.2 AA target and stricter Naya house control-size rule are verified
Existing required Smart Factory features pass the existing 13-feature contract
Human approval is recorded wherever the governing project or governance contract requires it
Deployment and production claims are backed by exact receipts and independent observation

release_decision.READY: Every dimension is at least 9.0, every hard gate passes, and the independent verifier recommends release.
release_decision.AAA: Every dimension is at least 9.5 and all hard gates pass.
release_decision.BLOCKED: Any hard gate fails, a critical fact is unknown, or any dimension is below 9.0.
release_decision.NOT_APPLICABLE: Allowed only with a written reason and owner; it cannot be used to conceal missing work.
